name: Josiah
overview: Josiah, identified as the son of Zephaniah in Zechariah 6:10, was a king of Judah and an ancestor of Jesus Christ according to Matthew 1:10-11. The genealogy in Matthew highlights Josiah's role in the Messianic lineage, linking him directly to the fulfillment of God's redemptive plan through Christ. These verses emphasize Josiah's historical and theological significance within the biblical narrative.
